text:
Maya Chen: Quick check-in from design review — compact scorecard approve flow. Noticed a few UX/a11y pain points: modal focus, ambiguous CTA copy, and confirmation discoverability.

Samir Patel: Repro'd. Approve modal opens and focus jumps into the list; screen reader keeps reading background items.

Jia Li: Missing a proper dialog pattern (role=dialog + aria-modal). Proposed tab order: close -> Approve -> reason input -> examples list -> secondary actions. Also add a visible focus outline in compact mode.

Nina (Design): Copy feels heavy right now: `Approve results`. I'd prefer `Approve run` with helper text `Approves all examples in this run.` Keeps the CTA short but clear.

Leo (Product): Short label seems right for dense layouts. Helper text below CTA is good.

Maya Chen: Confirmation flow is weak — modal closes and a toast flashes then page refreshes. Suggest swap to in-modal success state for 4s with inline Undo, then auto-close. Reduces context loss and surfaces Undo.

Samir Patel: Implementation plan: swap body to success panel, add green highlight on approved rows, expose data-qa hooks, and prevent Escape from closing until undo period ends.

Jia Li: A11y notes: focus dialog container on open (tabindex=-1), ensure aria-live for the success toast (`Run approved — 24 examples`), and make Undo keyboard-focusable.

ux-bot: Staging scan: modal missing role=dialog. Filed #1123.

Maya Chen: Action items: Samir — modal + success state + undo timer + QA hooks (Mon). Jia — two copy variants A: `Approve run` B: `Approve all` + helper line (Tue). Nina — success mock + mobile undo layout (Wed). I'll review after PR lands.

Samir Patel: Will open a staging PR and link QA checks.

Nina (Design): :ok_hand:

Leo (Product): Thanks, ship `Approve run` by default unless testing shows issues.

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone — following up in a short thread when PR is ready.
